program: General tilted-Bianchi extension and observational convergence of HTT tensorized five-view inference

companion_code_repair.required_local_action: Review and integrate this code-repair branch in a dedicated local worktree before modifying consumers; resolve conflicts and rerun affected tests.

objective: Move the programme from Bianchi-I-centred transfer to general Class-A/Class-B tilted Bianchi dynamics and a common source-bound tensor likelihood, then analyze existing real data without requiring new acquisitions or NPIPE matched simulations.

research_loop_selection.reason: The interrupted work needed literature/reuse, claim alignment, constructive model design, computational formalization and handoff. Production C5-C9 remain local tasks, not falsely marked complete.

global_invariants: normal N, every fluid u_s, radiation frame, observer O and catalogue frame remain distinct
dimensionless tilt V_s is a 3-vector; scalar beta and vhat are derived coordinates only
family/type admissibility is derived from complete constraints and matter content
single perfect-fluid Bianchi-I genuine tilt is forbidden under declared standard assumptions; re-interpret legacy beta or prove a multi-fluid exception
all Class-A and Class-B types remain in the candidate family registry
exact Lorentz composition and Wigner rotation are propagated to tensors, polarization and covariance
all HTT five views are pushed from one common law
no zeros, fake maps, random directions, identity covariance or hard-coded data as observed inputs
no PR3 FFP10 treated as PR4 matched null
no claim of Bianchi family detection without family-specific physical transfer and calibrated competition
retain source hashes, code SHA, configs, row IDs, masks, beam, selection and covariance provenance
never force-push, reset, clean or stash a dirty user workspace

workstreams.title: R48 and legacy source/claim reconciliation
acceptance: all facts tied to exact source path/ref
historical claims retained but empirical unsupported claims quarantined
Bianchi-I restriction traced to hierarchy/RHS coverage, not to the type registry

workstreams.title: All-family geometry and convention bridge
acceptance: Jacobi and type classification for all 11 types
Class-A/Class-B axis and sign convention round-trip
h=-1 and h=-1/9 boundary handling
SO(3) and handedness transformations verified

workstreams.title: Vector-tilt physical state and type-specific constraint fibres
acceptance: V_s^alpha is a true vector per species
normal-fluid kinematics are separately computed
Bianchi I single-fluid invalid branch is rejected under stated assumptions
known tilted II/VI0/VIh/III-IV-V-VIIh branches are regression fixtures
VIII/IX vorticity branches are not forced to zero

workstreams.title: General Class-A/Class-B tilted Einstein evolution
acceptance: all constraints satisfied at IC and every accepted time step
full STF shear and one V_s vector per species
FLRW/untilted/known exact limits recovered
adaptive convergence and independent geometric oracle agree
no reduced family code is silently promoted to generic all-type support

workstreams.title: General-family null propagation and polarized CMB transfer
outputs: transfer registry by type and validity domain
acceptance: Bianchi-I endpoint reproduced
V/VIIh and other available literature-compatible templates reproduced
polarization basis and Wigner rotations tracked
curvature/handedness and class-B terms tested
non-FLRW-limit families use a non-perturbative branch or remain unavailable

workstreams.title: Common source-bound tensor likelihood and HTT five-view
acceptance: no default zero/diagonal fallback
CMB mean and covariance use one generative law
count/astrometry/distance source and selection operators bound
cross-probe covariance or explicit conditional dependence model
all five views derived from the same posterior

workstreams.title: Existing-data intake and Planck calibrated bypass
acceptance: local files rehashed and headers inspected
PR3 observed maps and FFP10 same-release simulations matched
mask/beam/transfer resolved
injection and coverage calibrated
NPIPE never uses PR3 simulations as its matched null
no new download required for the minimum viable result

workstreams.title: Adversarial benchmark versus established methods
acceptance: same data/operators/priors where possible
false family identification under action-equivalent metrics measured
SBC/coverage/PPC and leave-one-probe-out scores
document where HTT wins, ties, loses or is not comparable

workstreams.title: Production inference and scientific adjudication
acceptance: code/config/data hashes recorded
split-Rhat, ESS, SBC, PPC and coverage pass
held-out predictions and adversarial benchmark pass
each promoted claim independently evidence-bound
unresolved type labels reported as admissible/action-equivalence sets

data_lanes.cmb_primary: Planck PR3 SMICA/HM plus same-release FFP10; matched null and coverage lane
data_lanes.cmb_robustness: NPIPE PR4 observed maps after transfer harmonization; half-ring noise-only diagnostic
data_lanes.cmb_synthetic_optional: NPIPE synthetic C_l plus validated noise model; explicitly SYNTHETIC/TRANSFER_CONDITIONAL

allowed: local code changes on a dedicated branch/worktree
updates to the R49 branch after tests
forbidden: raw data or chains in Git
new external data downloads without separate need
pre_write: verify no dirty/untracked source files will be overwritten
push: update the existing R49 draft PR only
